law_conformance.note: The frozen oracle has route-shaped token accounting but not the PC2 fresh/inclusive split or per-leaf durable provenance. This corpus therefore executes the ratified foundational usage and provider-accounting laws rather than inventing oracle semantics.

preserves: Responses and Codex report inclusive input; fresh input is derived only from a complete checked cache partition.
Anthropic reports fresh input; inclusive input is derived only from a complete checked partition.

OpenAI-compatible usage reports inclusive input, cache read and any reported cache write (prompt_tokens_details.cache_write_tokens); an omitted cache write stays absent while fresh input uses the route's exact zero-write equation; explicit null also leaves fresh input unknown.
Every present leaf is bounded to the inclusive exact-token domain 0 through 2^53 and retains reported or named-derived provenance.

Missing and null optional fields remain absent, distinct from observed zero. Malformed, over-bound, over-partitioned and cross-total-mismatched reports keep typed normalization errors; streams retain a bounded warning and complete with usage unknown.
intentionally_excludes: Provider billing or price inference. Token usage and cost truth are separate.
Any billable provider request. All wire objects are authored fixture literals.
Provider-specific identities in durable usage observations.

determinism.network: No network access or provider call occurs.
determinism.filesystem: The test reads this bounded corpus and its expected files without writing them.

record_contracts.actions: One bounded JSON object per line. route selects one real adapter normalizer, wire is the provider-shaped input, and expect is the exact model-agnostic accepted, absent, or typed-refusal projection.
record_contracts.durable: Empty by law: provider normalization itself performs no durable write; the runtime/event witnesses own persistence.
record_contracts.state: Accepted, absent and refused counts plus route counts are recomputed by executing every action.

evidence.claim: Every action drives a real Responses, Codex, Anthropic or Compatible normalizer and compares the exact per-leaf values and provenance or typed refusal.
Legacy v1 input remains readable without being relabeled as fresh or inclusive.
